entities.summary: Artemi Viktorovich Lakiza is a Russian born Kazakhstani professional ice hockey defenceman. He is currently playing for HC Almaty in the Kazakhstan Hockey Championship (KAZ). He has formerly played with top tier Kazakh club, Barys Astana in the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL).
